order_book: We are pleased to share that our current order book stands at approximately INR 95 crores providing strong revenue visibility for the coming years and reinforcing the sustainability of our growth trajectory.
Khush Shah: Currently, the 50% of the order book is come from -- Kalpesh Goti: Yeah, average you can say 50% of the customers are repeated clients.
guidance: We are targeting the acquisition of projects with a value of more than INR 50 crore from government authorities.
Although private industry projects generally have smaller order sizes, we are targeting projects with an order value of more than INR 5 crore.
capex: Now this project will be commissioned by March 27.
Total capacity in the Phase 1 of CETP is 4,000 machines.
risks: In day-to-day life and everywhere, you can see, we are facing the challenges like water scarcity.
focus: For the last 15 years, GreenLeaf has focused on one thing, execution.
Today, industries are increasingly focused on water security, water reuse, resource efficiency, sustainability commitments and long-term environmental risk management.
The environmental infrastructure and sustainability sector itself is entering a very exciting phase of growth.
